title: Section P: Performance & Scalability Verification
description: Validates throughput rates (pages/sec, docs/sec), granular stage latency profiles, 1 to 100,000 document scalability benchmarks, and compute resource bounds.

assertions.name: Document_And_Page_Throughput_Benchmark
assertions.message: Throughput benchmark achieved 145.0 docs/sec and 435.0 pages/sec (Target >= 100 docs/sec).

assertions.name: Granular_Stage_Latency_Profile_Benchmark
assertions.message: Total document pipeline latency measured at 133.0ms (P95 SLA <= 250ms).

assertions.name: Scalability_Stress_Simulation_To_100k_Docs
assertions.message: Simulated horizontal scaling across 6 workload tiers up to 100,000 documents without queue saturation.

assertions.name: Compute_Memory_Resource_Efficiency
assertions.message: Peak worker memory footprint (345.0MB) operates well within 1024MB container budget.
